name: Prit Patel
positioning: I build high-throughput systems and precision web interfaces. 400+ PRs and algorithmic solutions in production.
aboutParagraphs: I build at the intersection of AI, systems architecture, and precision digital interfaces. Engineering software for me is fundamentally about crafting deterministic systems that think, adapt, and scale—from autonomous security scanner swarms to low-latency LLM retrieval gateways.

Currently pursuing Computer Science with a 9.67 GPA, I have solved 400+ algorithmic problems on LeetCode and engineered production-grade platforms across asynchronous socket meshes, RAG embedding pipelines, and compiler runtimes.
Outside the code editor, I analyze distributed network protocols, build toy language parsers in native idioms, and rigorously study the mechanics of low-level software engineering.

principles.title: Proof before poetry
principles.desc: Every engineering claim must be backed by reproducible benchmark metrics, unit tests, and measurable production logs.

principles.title: Systems-first reasoning
principles.desc: Understand network I/O, backpressure limits, and kernel socket boundaries before applying high-level application abstractions.

principles.title: Strict type boundaries
principles.desc: End-to-end typing from database schemas to client components prevents runtime regressions before code leaves development.

principles.title: Break it to build it
principles.desc: Stress-test edge cases under simulated network partition and concurrency saturation before declaring any architecture ready.

principles.title: Aggressive code subtraction
principles.desc: The best code is the code never written. Delete speculative boilerplate and rely on native platform primitives.
